name: Keyward property maintenance desk
description: A residential property maintenance desk: buildings, maintenance tickets with fix-by dates, quarterly inspection rounds, vendors' service contracts, and an inspection-intake specialist (a full workspace: seven format skills, six scripts with self-tests, a schema and a validator).

state.workspace: This workspace runs maintenance for residential buildings: buildings are the accounts; maintenance tickets carry a place, a trade, a vendor and a fix-by date; inspection rounds hold each quarter's tickets; service contracts say which vendor covers which trade.
